name: Quantity stepper
summary: Choose an amount with − and +. You can also type. The value stays between min and max, and follows the order unit (step) when there is one.
use: Amount in the cart and on the product page.
Bulk orders: a minimum order and an order unit, for example per 25.
avoid: Money amounts or numbers without limits: use Input with type number.
anatomy: Number (native number field). It grows with the largest number.
Optional line below: a hint, or a message after a correction.
figmaProps: Default, Hover, Focus value, Focus button, Disabled, At minimum, At maximum
Focus value: ring around the stepper while typing. Focus button: ring inside the button. At minimum: − is off. At maximum: + is off.
The field grows with the number.
The line below the stepper. Also used for the message after a correction.
reactProps: Default 1 and 99. Give a higher max for bulk orders; the field grows with it.
Order unit, default 1. − and + go per step. A typed number is rounded up to the next step.
Line below the stepper, for example "Add 20 more for €0.48 each". You fill it yourself: the stepper knows no prices.
Accessible name, for example "Quantity Wool sweater".
{ decrease, increase, decreaseBy(step), increaseBy(step), minimum(min), maximum(max), stepped(value, step) }
behaviour: A typed value is checked on Enter or when you leave the field.

A number that is too low, too high or not a multiple of the step is corrected. A message below the stepper says why: "Minimum is 50", "Maximum is 5000" or "Changed to 75. Sold per 25." The message goes away at the next change.
Valid numbers are multiples of the step. With step 12 and min 1 the lowest number is 12.
While a message shows, it takes the place of the hint, so there is always one line.
− is off at the minimum, + at the maximum. They keep focus (aria-disabled), so you can keep pressing without losing your place.
a11y: Native number field: arrow up and down work, per step.
The message is a status: a screen reader reads it when it appears. The hint or the message is also the description of the field.
With a step the buttons are named after it: "25 less", "25 more".
The buttons have their own names and point to the field (aria-controls).
Focus is visible on the part that has it: a ring inside − or +, a ring around the stepper for the field.
content: Keep the hint to one short line.
The default messages have no unit. Add one through labels when it helps: "Minimum is 50 pieces".
do: Give a label with the product name when there are several on one page.
dont: Allow 0 as a way to remove an item: use a remove button.
open: Assumption: valid numbers are multiples of the step counted from 0, and min and max move inward to the nearest multiple. Not built: a step that starts at the minimum (min 50, step 12: 50, 62, 74).
Assumption: a typed number is rounded up to the next step, so a customer never gets less than asked.
Assumption: the message has the same color as the hint, because the number is already right. Not tested whether it stands out enough.
Add to cart and Cart item do not pass min and step yet.
